name: embedded-tiers
description: U15 materialized: the AC codes of all three channels merged by frequency priority, so a truncated payload is still a valid low-frequency reconstruction. Rows labelled 'trunc N' encode a full tier-1 hash (108 B) and decode only its first N bytes - what a progressive consumer would actually see. The 'seq' rows do the same on the shipped channel-sequential order, which is the control: a sequential prefix carries all of luma and none of the chroma. The Bytes column is the ENCODED size; the truncation is in the label.
